name: Very Merrytime Christmas Menu: Virginia Ham & Cheddar Croquettes vs. Marmalade Glazed Ham (Citrus Warning)
brandOrRestaurant: Disney Wonder, Magic & Treasure · Very Merrytime "Happy Holidays" Dinner Menu
searchKeywords: virginia ham and white cheddar croquettes
whyItWorks: Critical holiday warning: while the Virginia Ham & White Cheddar Croquette starter is citrus-free, the Baked Virginia Ham entrée is glazed with bitter orange peel marmalade.
prepOrOrderInstructions: Strictly skip the Marmalade-Glazed Baked Virginia Ham (or ask the kitchen for an unglazed center cut of ham with zero orange marmalade); choose the Holiday Roast Turkey or Rib Roast instead.
watchOuts: Orange peel marmalade glaze on the Christmas Ham (strict citrus guardrail)
